prompt: This workflow reinstalls npm dependencies from scratch on every run. Add a step that caches them using actions/cache.
seed:
name: CI
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: 18
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm test

source.dataset: Decan & Mens, "On the outdatedness of workflows in the GitHub Actions ecosystem", Journal of Systems and Software 2023
source.note: Seed pins actions/checkout@v3 and actions/setup-node@v3 with node 18: real, widely-used version choices from the study's 2019-2022 data collection window, now stale.
